content:
LAREDO — A Laredo man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday on a first-degree felony drug charge, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

David Alexis De Leon was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 11:47 a.m. The booking record charges him with manufacture or delivery of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 1, in an amount of 4 grams or more but less than 200 grams — a first-degree felony under Texas law. Bond had not been set as of booking, and the record does not list an arresting agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
